# Frozen Adhytm astronomy engine

Backend-only snapshot of astronomy + common libraries, packaged as `com.adhytm.*`.

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `astronomy-kotlin/` | `com.adhytm.astronomy` |
| `common-kotlin/` | `com.adhytm.common` |
| `UPSTREAM_COMMIT.txt` | Source git SHA at original freeze |
| `FROZEN_AT.txt` | Original freeze time (UTC) |
| `REBRANDED_AT.txt` | When packages were renamed to `com.adhytm` |

Copied from the previous `third_party/vedic-mitra` freeze (same sources). The old directory is left intact and unused by the build.
